theme: ceilings CE-6 token cap counts the reply; O-AF-09 billed unusable replies charged
text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): the run token cap (AXON_BUDGET_TOKENS, a ceiling's ai_tokens) now reserves prompt bytes + 16 + the 1024-token reply cap before every model call, ai_extract::<T> included, and refuses with E1303 (exit 5) before dispatch when that does not fit; after the call it charges what was used (live: provider usage; mock/replay: prompt + reply length estimate). Before, each ai_complete was charged a prompt-length estimate only and extracts were not charged, so a cap below ~1100 that used to admit a call now refuses it. In an asi-runtime build a billed live reply the code cannot use is now recorded as an ai_call (reason 'unusable reply'), costed and charged before the program gets its Err; before, it returned Err with nothing recorded or charged. Runs without AXON_BUDGET_TOKENS or a ceiling ai_tokens see no pass/fail change.
